conflicts_and_completions: Eq.1 is an L-infinity square exclusion, not Euclidean 5D distance. Production uses Euclidean 5D and exposes the literal equation as a sensitivity mode.
Eq.7 gives transformer cost per MW but omits turbine count. Production multiplies by complete-farm rated capacity.
Eqs.9-10 are implicit shares of ICC. Production solves ICC=direct/(1-0.043-0.174).
Eq.11 divides capital by instantaneous expected MW and is named capital-to-power proxy rather than lifecycle LCOE.
Zero turbines makes Eq.11 undefined; executable layouts therefore contain 1-25 turbines.

For S1W1 and S1W3, both 18 turbines on zero-depth terrain should have identical ICC, yet paper COE times displayed power implies about GBP139.8m versus GBP244.3m. S1W2/S1W4 have the same contradiction at 23 turbines. Table anchors are reported but never forced through wind-dependent capital calibration.
Rated power is absent. A 2.3MW completion preserves the paper cost scale; aerodynamic power remains the literal uncapped Eq.2 curve.
Ambient turbulence is absent and completed as0.08 for the cited offshore Qian-Ishihara model.
S4 is shifted/scaled to satisfy the paper's stated common mean and standard deviation; S5 is a frozen analytic irregular proxy with those same moments.
W2-W4 are normalized analytic digitizations. Their no-wake per-turbine powers reproduce the visible Table7-10 scales, but they are not the private arrays.

The cited same-author MATLAB scripts complete population100 generations500 and crossover0.3. Rank selection, five elites, scattered crossover and bounded count/coordinate mutation are declared executable completions.

strategy: immutable normalized wind-state and terrain constants
one persistent full-core executor for count-preserving initialization, frozen-generation offspring and complete individual evaluations
parallel fixed-index population work with ordered rank and elite commits
serial physics within one individual to avoid nested teams and oversubscription
